description:
Issue-id resolution accepts a full-length id only in its exact stored spelling on some commands and in any case or hyphenation on others. The same id therefore resolves on `issue update` and fails on `issue show` and `gate evaluate`.

## Background

Ids are matched case-insensitively and with hyphens ignored, and a prefix must normalise to at least four characters. Several resolvers implement this rule independently, and they disagree at the full-length boundary.

- `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:1264` and `crates/jit/src/storage/memory.rs:848`: when the normalised input is 32 characters, `resolve_issue_id` loads the issue by the raw input instead of the normalised form. An uppercase or hyphen-free full id finds no record and returns "Issue not found".
- `crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:737`: gate evaluation compares a 32-character input with `id.as_str() == requested`, which fails the same way.
- `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:262` (mutation preflight) matches on the normalised form and accepts both spellings. It applies no minimum-length check. A prefix shorter than four characters, including the empty string, reads every matching issue record before `resolve_issue_from_capture` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2000`) rejects it.

Reproduction in a fresh repository, with an issue `b53beeba-32f2-4671-a407-2d94e4d13d41` that has an automated gate `ok`:

| Input | `issue show` | `issue update` | `gate evaluate` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `B53BEEBA-32F2-4671-A407-2D94E4D13D41` | not found | resolves | not found |
| `b53beeba32f24671a4072d94e4d13d41` | not found | resolves | not found |
| `b53beeba32f24671a4072d94e4d13d4` (31 chars) | resolves | resolves | resolves |

A 31-character prefix resolves, and the full id with one more character does not.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every command that accepts an issue id resolves a full id given in uppercase or without hyphens to the same issue as its canonical spelling.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every command rejects an id prefix that normalises to fewer than the minimum prefix length with the invalid-prefix error, before it reads any issue record.
- [hard] REQ-03: One shared function owns id normalisation and prefix matching. Every issue-id resolver resolves through it, including the storage backends, gate evaluation, mutation preflight, dependency commands and template commands.
- [hard] REQ-04: A regression test fails on the current code. It resolves an uppercase full id and a hyphen-free full id through storage resolution and through gate evaluation, and covers a prefix below the minimum length.

## Notes

Dependency commands (`crates/jit/src/commands/dependency.rs:458`) and template commands (`crates/jit/src/commands/template.rs:911`) carry further copies of the matching rule. An id newtype is out of scope.
title: Resolve full-length issue ids regardless of case and hyphens on every command
